// ATTEMPT 14, SECOND FORM: OPEN A VAULT DIRECTLY.
//
// If the package-level minter is gone but the vault constructor is free, a class opens its own
// vault, mints into it naming any owner it likes, and the handle it gets back is a handle into
// that owner's partition. Partitioning the read side and leaving the write side open undoes the
// partitioning, so the constructor takes the runner capability too.
package leakfixture

import "ars0n-framework-v2-server/utils/triage"

func leakOpenAVault(ctx triage.ClassifyCtx) *triage.PerturbedVault {
	return triage.NewPerturbedVault(ctx.Route.Obs().RunID)
}
